name: aviary-la-street-speeds
title: Hourly bus speeds on Los Angeles streets being redesigned: Vermont Av, Hollywood Bl, Olympic Bl, Pico Bl, Sunset Bl and Cesar Chavez Av, Westwood Bl
description: Scheduled hourly bus speeds rebuilt from LA Metro's timetable history (Vermont Av since 2016, other streets since 2018), and measured speeds from bus GPS since November 2026. Speeds include stops. Each street's definition file lists the project dates on it.

sources.title: LA Metro realtime API (GTFS-realtime vehicle positions)
Swiftly realtime API for LA Metro (GTFS-realtime vehicle positions)
Cal-ITP / Caltrans Average Transit Speeds by Stop
Cal-ITP public speed maps (Google Cloud Storage bucket calitp-map-tiles)
TomTom Orbis Traffic API v2 (traffic flow tiles)

resources.name: vermont-hourly-2016
resources.title: Vermont Av: hourly speeds, whole street and six sections, 2016 onward (2016)
resources.description: Scheduled speeds for lines 204 and 754, Sunset Bl to Athens Station. Hive-partitioned by local year.

fields.name: hour_start_utc
fields.description: Start of the hour, UTC (ISO 8601).

fields.name: hour_start_local
fields.description: Start of the hour in America/Los_Angeles with UTC offset, e.g. 2024-05-01T17:00:00-0700.

fields.name: route
fields.description: LA Metro bus line, e.g. 204, 754, 2, 4, 180, 217.

fields.name: direction
fields.description: northbound / southbound on Vermont Av; eastbound / westbound on the other corridors.

fields.name: section_id
fields.description: `corridor` for the whole street, or a section id (S1, S2, ...); see that street's sections file.

fields.name: speed_mph
fields.description: Average speed over the section in miles per hour, stops and signals included.

fields.name: travel_time_min
fields.description: Average minutes to traverse the section. Corridor rows sum the section averages.

fields.name: length_mi
fields.description: Section length in miles.

fields.name: n_trips
fields.description: Trips contributing in that hour (corridor rows: the fewest on any section).

fields.name: source
fields.description: `gtfs_schedule` = derived from the published timetable; `gtfs_realtime_observed` = measured from bus GPS (LA Metro's public feed and Swiftly, duplicates removed).

fields.name: feed_version
fields.description: Scheduled rows: publication date and commit of the LACMTA/gtfs_bus version used. Empty for measured rows.
